title: fix(lint): field-no-consumers credits a related list's columns to the child object it lists
body:
Fixes #37502

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:搭建者运行校验或检查命令时,父对象上一个没有任何地方显示的字段,如果恰好和子对象关联列表里的某列同名,现在会被正确提示;子对象被关联列表显示的字段不再被误报。
- 为什么做:属于“字段无人使用”检查规则的后续修补,替使用空白模板起步的搭建者解决漏报问题。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是多出或少出一条警告,规则仍只是警告、不拦截任何保存或发布,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- `field-no-consumers` (`@objectstack/lint`, run by `os validate` and `os lint`) now reads an object-form `relatedLists` entry against the CHILD object its `list` names (`child`, or the head of `child.field`), never against the object that declares the list. The entry's `columns` are the child's field names (`RelatedListEntryObjectSchema`), so each column is a display site of the child's field.
- Before: a column was credited to the declaring parent's field of the same name. On the blank starter, the company's related list of contacts has a `phone` column, which kept an undisplayed `company.phone` silent, and the contact's own `phone` got no credit from the column.
- A list naming a child this stack does not declare credits no object (the columns count as unresolved, like any other field-shaped token that lands nowhere).
- Side effect, same mechanism: the `child.field` spelling in `list` now credits that relationship field on the child as a read (the list joins on it); before, the token was tried against the parent.
- The test helper `withoutPlacement` in `packages/cli/test/starter-field-consumers.test.ts` is narrowed back: it strips the control field only from related lists of the control's OWN object, so the blank-template control `blank_company.phone` now exercises the fixed rule instead of the helper hiding the defect.
- The rule stays `warning`. ADR check: the dispatch named ADR-0139 D4; that decision governs the plugin-audit read gates (parent-record leaves, no pre-scan) and does not touch this rule, so there is no conflict. No ADR governs field-consumer crediting beyond the module header, which is updated.

## Files to read first

1. `packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.ts` — `isRelatedListEntry` / `relatedListChildOf` and the one changed line in `walk` (the risk hunk: which records switch context).
2. `packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.test.ts` — the new `[#37502]` describe (both directions pinned).
3. `packages/cli/test/starter-field-consumers.test.ts` — `withoutPlacement`, narrowed.

## Tests

Head `bc95079f7`, worktree of `objectstack-ai/objectstack`.

<details><summary>lint: new pins, full suite, typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-field-consumers.test.ts`: Tests 201 passed (201).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 236 passed (236), Tests 9687 passed (9687).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0 (test layer: test-typecheck OK, debt unchanged).
- Ablation (fix committed first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 to 0, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty): with the walk reading the entry against the parent again, 4 of the 7 new cases go red (parent `phone` still reported; child column counts; `child.field`; undeclared child), 197 others pass.

</details>

<details><summary>cli: the blank-template control, red before and green after</summary>

- With the narrowed helper against the unfixed lint `dist` (built from `origin/main` c385d3bd1): Tests 1 failed, 24 passed (25). The failure: `npm create objectstack: blank_company.phone without its group is reported by both commands`, `os validate: expected [] to deeply equal [ 'objects[0].fields.phone' ]`. This is the premise, measured on current main.
- After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build` (dist carries the fix): Tests 25 passed (25).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Sweep: shipped apps and the blank template, old rule vs new rule</summary>

Every finding of `validateFieldConsumers` over each loaded stack, with the lint dist built from the fix and from an ablated copy (old reading):

- `examples/app-crm`: 0 and 0. `examples/app-starter`: 0 and 0. Blank template: 0 and 0. `examples/app-todo`: the same 5 pre-existing `todo_task` findings both ways.
- `examples/app-showcase` and `examples/app-multi-package` did not load in this container (unbuilt dependencies). Neither declares an object-form `relatedLists` entry, and the change only alters the subtree of such an entry, so neither can move.
- No new warning in any shipped app or template, so nothing that passed `os lint --strict` before refuses now.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A related list entry with no `columns` draws the child FK's `relatedListColumns` or the child's derived columns; the rule credits neither of those derived columns (unchanged behaviour, under-crediting direction, outside this card).

## Verification

Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-field-consumers.test.ts -t 37502` — expect 7 passed, including "a column credits the CHILD's field: the parent's same-name phone is still reported".
